cards.front: What key point should you remember from Prime Time?
cards.back: 5 PRIME TIME 5.1 Common Multiples and Common Factors Idli-Vada Game Children sit in a circle and play a game of numbers.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Prime Time?
cards.back: But when it is the turn of 3, 6, 9, … (multiples of 3), the player should say ‘idli’ instead of the number.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Prime Time?
cards.back: When it is the turn of 5, 10, … (multiples of 5), the player should say ‘vada’ instead of the number.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Prime Time?
cards.back: When a number is both a multiple of 3 and a multiple of 5, the player should say ‘idli-vada’!

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Prime Time?
cards.back: The game continues in rounds till only one person remains.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Prime Time?
cards.back: For which numbers should the players say ‘idli’ instead of saying the number?
